_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from Hugging Face's Inference Providers router listing to
pricing.json entries. Nothing here is inferred at runtime: no fuzzy matching, no
lowercasing and hoping.
The unit of pricing on this source is a (model, partner) PAIR, not a model. Hugging
Face routes a call to whichever partner actually serves the model, and the same
model is served by several at several prices -- openai/gpt-oss-120b is offered by
eleven partners, from $0.05 to $0.35 per million input tokens. So the key is the
string the router itself takes, '<model id>:<partner>', the form Hugging Face's own
documentation uses ("openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq"). A key without the suffix would
name eleven different prices at once.
Only two partners are covered here, by request: ovhcloud and scaleway. The router
lists fourteen. Widening the set is a one-line change to 'partners' plus the new
routes in 'models' -- and reading every one of their prices first.
A price here is what the partner charges THROUGH the router, which is not the price
of calling that partner directly. OVHcloud's own catalog prices Qwen3.6-27B at 0.40
EUR; the router quotes 0.47 USD for the same model on the same partner. Both are
correct and both are in this file, under their own provider. providers.huggingface
is not a cross-check of providers.ovh.
Currency is USD, and the figures are already per MILLION tokens -- no scaling is
applied, unlike Eden AI's per-token source. Confirmed by cross-checking the seven
ovhcloud routes against OVH's own EUR catalog, which this repository publishes
independently under providers.ovh: every one tracks at the USD/EUR rate (0.40 EUR
agreeing to the conversion rate is what pins the unit and the currency here.
Routes whose status is not 'live' are refused rather than published: a price for a
call that cannot be served is worse than no price. A route Hugging Face marks
is_free is published with the shared "free": true marker and no price field, the
same as OVH's free models -- never as a price of 0.
Last verified against the endpoint by a human: 2026-08-10.
